text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One achieved great results in the 
Takarazuka Kinen, earning recognition as a 
contender closing in on Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, so as not to rest on her laurels 
after today's result, Inari One kept her 
guard up even after the race ended.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next major target: the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). Oguri Cap and Super Creek are 
almost certain to enter the fray as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Choosing to aim for the Mainichi Okan as a 
prelude to the Tenno Sho (Autumn), she set 
off on a new step forward.
